title: How Wet-Biased Datasets Shape the Training and Mislead the Evaluation of Generative Precipitation Nowcasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.26486v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Generative models for precipitation nowcasting are trained and evaluated predominantly on wet-biased datasets, which over-represent precipitation events to emphasize rare extremes. Selecting test cases based on target observations is known to favor forecasts that match the selected distribution rather than the intended deployment distribution. We show analytically that the same target-dependent selection, applied to the training set, tilts the conditional distribution learned by an ideal generative model by exactly the factor that such an evaluation rewards. We test both evaluation and training effects with a satellite-to-radar diffusion model in a controlled experiment that crosses wet-biased and uniform sampling of the training and of the test set. translated_title: 湿偏数据集如何塑造生成式降水临近预报的训练并误导其评估
translated_abstract: 生成式降水临近预报模型的训练与评估主要基于湿偏数据集，这类数据集过度代表降水事件以突出罕见的极端情形。基于目标观测来选择测试用例已被认为会偏向于那些匹配所选分布而非实际部署分布的预报。我们从分析上证明，同样的目标依赖选择方法若应用于训练集，会使理想生成模型学到的条件分布发生偏移，其偏移因子恰好等于这种评估方式所奖励的因子。我们在一个受控实验中通过一个卫星到雷达的扩散模型检验了评估与训练两方面的影响，该实验将训练集与测试集的湿偏采样和均匀采样进行交叉组合。评估效应完全显现：无论模型如何训练，同一模型在湿偏测试集上显得预报不足，而在与部署一致的测试集上则对小雨预报偏多。
tldr: 本文通过理论与受控实验揭示，湿偏数据集不仅在评估阶段误导生成式降水临近预报模型的表现（使其在湿偏测试集上显得预报不足、在真实部署分布下过度预报小雨），而且在训练阶段同样因目标依赖采样使理想生成模型学到的条件分布产生恰好等于评估所奖励幅度的系统性偏移。
en_tdlr: Wet-biased datasets not only mislead the evaluation of generative precipitation nowcasting models but also systematically tilt the conditional distribution learned during training, with the target-dependent sampling-induced shift exactly matching the factor that such biased evaluation rewards.
